comment: Golden vectors for the SCM's canonical encoding (docs/scm.md, "Objects and identity").
Both internal/scm/encoding (Go) and jj's encoding (Rust) must encode every valid object to
exactly its bytes and ID, decode those bytes back to the same bytes, and reject every invalid input
with its error code. A byte string is the concatenation of its lines; each line is hex, and anything
after '#' is a comment. A file or chunk given by contents_repeat is its kind byte followed by the
pattern repeated count times. A commit with a secure_sig also lists its signed_data.
